caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape, rendered in shades of brown. The front of the chest is divided into three panels, each framed by vertical columns with decorative patterns consisting of alternating dark and light motifs. The left and right panels have rounded tops and feature floral designs in red, green, and blue on a light background. Each of these panels has a black tulip-like flower surrounded by smaller red flowers and leaves, and includes the inscription "CHRISTINA" on the left panel and "ERIK STIN" on the right panel, both beneath a stylized bird. The central panel is rectangular with a slightly ornate top edge, and displays symmetrical patterns of red flowers, green stems, and geometric shapes, along with a shell-like motif at the center. The chest sits on four short, round feet, and the overall composition is set against a plain, light background. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Dower Chest
